tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text:
Subject: Estate planning document request

Hello Nolan Wrenpuddle,

To help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:

- Will
- Revocable trust or other trust agreements
- Trust amendments or restatements
- Durable power of attorney
- Health care directive or medical power of attorney
- Beneficiary designation confirmations
- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details
- Any recent attorney summary letter

If another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: [________________].

Preferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]
Documents already on file: 2014 revocable trust and will
Documents still needed: Any later trust restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, attorney summary letter, and the binder Celia Thimblefern may have prepared after Carla’s death.

Thank you,
Apricot Compass Advisory
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Review IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Review the traditional IRA and Roth IRA beneficiary designations for Nolan Wrenpuddle. The traditional IRA lists Lena and Oscar equally, while the Roth IRA still lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary. Assess whether both accounts should pass directly to the children and identify any specific reason to retain the trust as Roth beneficiary.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Review successor trustee sequence and authority evidence
tickets.text: Review the successor trustee sequence in Nolan Wrenpuddle’s 2014 revocable trust and the evidence of trustee authority. Carla Wrenpuddle is named first successor trustee, followed by Priya Nettlewhisk. Determine whether Priya signed any trustee acceptance and assess whether another child should be added later. Address the implications for the estate review and possible future trust account administration.
